desc: Elevate your shooting precision with the Allen Company Lite Rest Solo Shooting Rest. This versatile shooting rest is perfect for the range, hunting blind, or varmint shooting off the hood of your truck. Offering two adjustable shooting heights of 4.5" and 6.5", it provides optimal elevation for sight-in or hunting. Made from durable closed-cell foam, this shooting rest is moisture-resistant and lightweight, weighing just 2.2 ounces. Its stiff yet soft construction ensures a stable shooting platform while preventing scratches on surfaces. Trust the Allen Company for reliable and high-quality shooting accessories, proudly Made in the USA.
